Who am I?

Software Developer · Entrepreneur · Founder of Mitfly ↗ · Creator of WidGefter YouTube ↗

Hi, I’m Samir Bekirli. I’m a software developer and entrepreneur building web applications, SaaS products, and AI-powered tools.

I’m the founder of Mitfly, an intelligent flight search and comparison platform designed to make travel planning easier across hundreds of airlines and booking agencies, and the creator of WidGefter, a YouTube channel where I share startup journeys, entrepreneurship, and software engineering insights.

We are actively developing the Mitfly core flight search engine, data integrations, and fine-tuning the user experience for peak performance.
